msItem.title: Chronicon abbatie de Parco Lude
msItem.note: Partially printed by E. Venables, Chronicon abbatiae de Parco Lude, Lincoln Record Society 1 (1891), siglum V; identification of this manuscript, now in a public collection, as V was made by T. Russell Smith in The Library, 7th ser. 21 (2020), 98--101.

provenance.orgName: Louth Park, Lincolnshire. Cistercian abbey of St Mary the Virgin
provenance.p: Provenance inferred from contents: Chronicon abbatie de Parco Lude.

history.provenance: Owned by Henry Harrod, antiquary, at his death on 24 January 1871. Acquired by William Allison of Louth, 1891, described in the Lincs Rec. Soc. edition of that year as owner of the abbey site.
March 1940 in possession of Mr J. N. Allison, 129 Dorset Road, Bexhill on Sea; but owned by his nephew Major W. W. Allison, Flackwell Heath (Bucks).
In March 1962 in possession of Mr R. W. Allison, Two Trees Links Rd., but owned by his father Brigadier W. W. Allison, Lambricks, Tregoney, Truro, Cornwall.
20 October 1991, bought by Martin Schøyen through Jeremy Griffiths, becoming Oslo and London, Schøyen Collection, MS 1373.
14 April 2005, purchased from the Schøyen Collection through Bernard Quaritch Ltd, becoming New Haven, Yale University, MS Osbern fa44.

recordHist.source: Neil R. Ker, ed., Medieval Libraries of Great Britain: A List of Surviving Books, Royal Historical Society Guides and Handbooks, 3 (London, 1941; 2nd edn, 1964; supplement, ed. Andrew G. Watson, 1987; digital edn, ed. Richard Sharpe and James M. W. Willoughby, 2010–15).
